context: Sho-young presents Naoko with a drawing of her ramen shop.
purpose: Child gift-giving to gruff aunt; warmth under the bluster.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ナオコおばちゃん、絵描いた!
lines.style: Bright, unguarded joy. Quick opening attack. Soft and small but genuine. Seeking approval with complete transparency—no filter between thought and words.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: おっ、店の絵か?嬉しいやん!
lines.en: Oh—a picture of the shop? That makes me so happy!
lines.style: Immediate, booming delight. Kansai warmth crackling through. Loud but genuinely moved—not performing brightness but living in it. Laughs a little on the realization.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quiet hope with a thread of vulnerability. Small hesitation before the final word—he's checking her face, not quite believing she means it. Breathless almost, waiting.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: めっちゃ上手や、飾るで!
lines.en: Really good—I'm putting it up right now!
lines.style: Brassy, immediate certainty. No hedging. Loud warmth with teeth in it—the kind of aunt who moves fast and means it. Affection delivered like a fact, not a feeling.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Pure, uncontained triumph. The 'yes' is almost a shout—relief and joy landing at once. Breathless gratitude tumbling out. The sound of being believed in.
